conclusion: 今日主线是: agent 工作台正在从“更多工具能接入”进入“哪些上下文绝不能被 agent 看到、哪个模型默认被团队采用、手机派工时证据如何随队列移动”的治理阶段。GitHub 9 月 2 日把 Copilot app/CLI 的 content exclusions 推到 GA，并允许企业托管任意默认模型；Copilot CLI 1.0.83-2 又把 custom agent 的模型候选白名单和 Linux sandbox 代理出站限制写进 prerelease。OpenAI 侧，Healthcare Public Data 插件强调公共医疗数据只读和 PHI 排除，ChatGPT iOS 1.2026.237 强化附件、后台发送、Priority view 和 thread ID 复制，Codex 0.153 alpha 继续滚动但 release body 为空，说明应观察但不能替代稳定版验收。
excerpt: 2026-09-03 的重点是内容排除 GA、企业默认模型、Healthcare Public Data 边界和移动附件队列。
今天的判断很明确: AI 越能干，越要先规定它不能看什么、默认用什么、谁能批准和哪里验收。

signals.title: Content exclusions generally available in Copilot app and CLI
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot app and Copilot CLI now respect enterprise, organization, and repository content exclusion policies, so excluded files are not used as context across agentic workflows.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Create a Context Exclusion Contract before agent runs: excluded paths, policy level, applicable tools, exception approver, and post-run public-boundary scan.

signals.title: Enterprise-managed settings support any default model
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Enterprise administrators can set the default Copilot model for new conversations and customize defaults by enterprise team through team mappings.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat default model selection as a config release: record model key, team mapping, overridable flag, rollout scope, and rollback path.

signals.title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.237 adds attachment-aware mobile queue controls
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT & Codex changelog
signals.summary: The iOS update emphasizes queued prompts, background sending, Priority view, file/image/PDF attachment support, work-time display, and thread ID copying for Codex Remote workflows.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use a Mobile Attachment Queue Envelope: origin device, attachment list, public/private mark, queue status, thread ID, and Mac/Codex final evidence.

signals.title: Healthcare plugins split organization data and public health data
signals.author: OpenAI Help / ChatGPT Release Notes
signals.summary: OpenAI describes healthcare plugins for EHR/claims integration and a Healthcare Public Data plugin for read-only public health information, with a warning not to send PHI to public sources.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Separate public medical-information lookup from personal health-data handling; PHI, claims, and records require an organization connector and explicit approval.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-2 adds custom-agent model lists and proxy egress control
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub releases
signals.summary: Custom agents can list several models tried in order and use a required model policy to keep changes on that list; Linux sandboxes can restrict network egress to the configured proxy.
signals.takeaway: 动作: For every execution channel, keep an allowed-model list and proxy-egress gate; do not allow silent fallback to unapproved models or direct network paths.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-3 ships a prerelease fixes batch
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub releases
signals.summary: The next Copilot CLI prerelease followed hours after 1.0.83-2 but only exposes a generic fixes-and-changes release body, so it is useful for cadence awareness rather than feature claims.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Track prerelease cadence separately from stable operating guidance; require concrete release notes before turning a prerelease into a workflow rule.

signals.title: Codex 0.153 alpha builds continue rolling after 0.152 stable
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: OpenAI published multiple 0.153 alpha builds around September 2-3, including 0.153.0-alpha.5.1 on September 3 UTC, while release bodies provide little behavioral detail.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep Codex 0.153 alpha in an observation lane and validate against stable 0.152.x before accepting any workflow change.

signals.title: Codex CLI 0.152.0 remains the stable runtime governance baseline
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The stable release documents MCP output_token_limit, longer app-server shellCommand timeouts, credential refresh progress, package-style MCP names, and trusted backend URL handling.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use 0.152.0 as the current stable checklist for long commands, MCP output ceilings, credential refresh state, and backend URL trust.

signals.title: Copilot code review can now approve pull requests
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot now surfaces approval assessments in reviews and can submit approvals only when administrators explicitly enable it; assessments alone do not count toward merge requirements.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep AI assessment, comments, formal approval, and required-approval rules as separate states in review governance.

signals.title: GitHub adds expiration dates for individual user budgets
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Administrators can set individual user budget overrides to expire at the next billing cycle or on a specific date, including through the Budgets REST API expires_at field.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Give temporary agent or model trials expiring budgets and include expires_at in every high-cost execution lane receipt.

signals.title: Claude Fable 5.1 is generally available in GitHub Copilot
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: The model targets long-horizon autonomous coding but carries data-retention requirements by default unless eligible enterprise zero-retention access is approved and enabled.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Before selecting a long-horizon coding model, record retention mode, zero-retention eligibility, administrator approval, and allowed surfaces.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK Python 0.22.0 hardens replay and usage accounting
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The release redacts blocked terminal output from replayable state, rejects terminal failed/incomplete Responses, rejects ignored explicit-client options, and isolates usage across RunState checkpoints.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Before SDK upgrades, test blocked-output replay, terminal failure handling, explicit-client rejection, and checkpoint usage isolation.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK JS 0.17.0 fails closed on ambiguous approval checkpoint replay
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The JS SDK blocks ambiguous serialized approval replays, withholds rejected final tool output in SDK-owned replay surfaces, and clarifies that external side effects are not undone automatically.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Define a replay-safe guardrail contract for live state, serialized checkpoints, new runs, and application-owned logs.

signals.title: ChatGPT App Store 1.2026.237 confirms current mobile build availability
signals.author: OpenAI / Apple App Store
signals.summary: The public App Store listing exposes the current ChatGPT mobile build stream, which helps cross-check whether a documented iOS workflow is plausibly available as an app update.
signals.takeaway: 动作: For mobile workflow claims, pair product changelog reading with public app-version readback, then still verify the user's device before relying on it.

knowledge.title: Context Exclusion Contract
knowledge.summary: 在 agent 装载上下文前定义哪些文件、路径和资料类型不能被读取或用于推理。
steps: 记录 enterprise、organization、repository 三层 exclusion 来源。
把 excluded paths、适用工具、适用 agent、例外审批人写成合同。
运行前读回配置，运行后做公开边界扫描。
knowledge.risk: 只靠 prompt 声明“不要看”不等于运行时真的不会装载。

knowledge.title: Managed Model Default Receipt
knowledge.summary: 把默认模型当作可审计配置发布，而不是个人偏好。
steps: 记录 model key、适用团队、team-mappings、是否允许用户覆盖和生效入口。
默认模型变更前确认隐私、保留策略、成本、工具兼容和回滚路径。
变更后抽样读回新会话默认值。
knowledge.risk: 默认模型一旦错配，会把错误成本扩散到所有新任务。

knowledge.title: Healthcare Public-Data Boundary
knowledge.summary: 公共医疗资料查询和个人健康数据处理必须分成两条通道。
steps: 标注问题是否只涉及公开资料。
PHI、病历、claims、账号内健康数据默认不进入公共数据插件。
需要组织健康数据时，单独确认连接器、权限、审计和输出边界。
knowledge.risk: 公共医学资料能回答问题，不代表它适合处理个人健康记录。

knowledge.title: Mobile Attachment Queue Envelope
knowledge.summary: 手机派工时把附件、队列状态、thread ID 和最终验收字段打包成任务信封。
steps: 记录 origin device、queued prompt、attachment list、background-send status 和 thread ID。
附件按公开、私有、需脱敏、禁止公开四类标记。
Mac/Codex 收口时补测试、diff、commit、push、deploy 证据。
knowledge.risk: 附件越容易随手发，越需要前置公开边界。

knowledge.title: Proxy-Egress Sandbox Gate
knowledge.summary: 把 sandbox 的网络出站限制到指定代理，并把代理凭证和域名范围当作独立 gate。
steps: 记录 proxy、证书/凭证来源、允许域名、工具范围和失败处理。
sandbox 里禁止绕过代理直接联网。
失败时先记录错误类型，不自动扩大网络权限。
knowledge.risk: “能联网”如果不分代理和域名，会把受控 agent 变成宽外联进程。
